NP Presspad 1.1.10 — Shortcodes survive editing

A fix for a bug that could permanently lose a shortcode from a post.

## What's new for you

- **Shortcodes stay shortcodes.** The app was pulling the version of your post that WordPress had already turned into finished HTML, so a shortcode like `[my_timeline]` arrived as the block of markup it produces. Editing that post and syncing wrote the markup back in its place, and the shortcode was gone for good. Posts are now pulled as their actual source, so shortcodes come down as shortcodes and go back up unchanged.
- **Your existing posts get repaired.** The next sync re-reads each post from your site once, replacing any stored copy that had a shortcode flattened into markup. Posts with unsynced edits or an unresolved conflict are left untouched — your own work always wins over the repair.

## One thing to check

If you already edited and synced a post that had a shortcode in it, that post's shortcode is gone on WordPress itself, so re-syncing can't bring it back. Open the post in wp-admin, use **Revisions** to restore the version from before the sync, then sync again — from here on the shortcode will hold.

Also worth knowing: preview now shows a shortcode as its literal text rather than the finished element, because the app has no theme or plugin runtime to expand it. That's an accurate view of what your post actually contains.

No dependency changes in this release.
